say:0:1222402001:0.text: Leonor's arguing with someone! That's unusual. Let's find out what's going on.
say:0:1222402001:0.source_cn: 咦，莱诺曼小姐居然在和人争吵，真是少见。我们去看看发生...

say:1:1222403001:1.text: Isn't your society looking for these fish? Now that I've brought them here, why don't you take them?
say:1:1222403001:1.source_cn: 你们协会不是说要收购特有的鱼吗，怎么我拿过来了又不肯收？

say:2:1222403002:1.text: I caught all these rare fish from the treacherous waters of the Blackthorn Sea. You won't find these fish elsewhere! Are you sure you don't want them?
say:2:1222403002:1.source_cn: 看看这些稀奇古怪的鱼，都是我从黑棘海里钓上来的，那地方...

say:3:1222403003:1.text: I'll reconsider if only you're willing to lower the price... at least by half!
say:3:1222403003:1.source_cn: 除非你肯降降价，我才能考虑一下……至少降一半！

say:4:1222403004:1.text: Half?! Hmph, that's not going to happen!
say:4:1222403004:1.source_cn: 降一半？！哼，那还是算了吧！

say:5:1222403005:1.text: I didn't risk my life and venture the Blackthorn Sea just for some peanuts!
say:5:1222403005:1.source_cn: 我冒着生命危险去黑棘海，不是为了挣这点钱！

say:7:1222403006:1.text: *Sigh* Rustport is such a rough-and-tumble place. Even the fishermen here are mean...
say:7:1222403006:1.source_cn: 唉，锈锚港真是个民风彪悍的地方，连捕鱼人都这么凶横……

choice_prompt:8:1222403006.text: *Sigh* Rustport is such a rough-and-tumble place. Even the fishermen here are mean...
choice_prompt:8:1222403006.source_cn: 唉，锈锚港真是个民风彪悍的地方，连捕鱼人都这么凶横……

say:9:1222403007:1.text: One fish for 10,000 gold! That's an outrageous price even by Rustport's standards!
say:9:1222403007:1.source_cn: 一条鱼就开价一万金币……！就算是在锈锚港，这价格也高得离谱！

say:10:1222403008:1.text: But those fish are indeed quite rare. The paper would be incomplete without including them...
say:10:1222403008:1.source_cn: 但那些鱼确实很奇特，如果缺少了对它们的研究，那研究报告...

say:11:1222403010:1.text: I wonder if there are other ways to get those fish from the Blackthorn Sea...
say:11:1222403010:1.source_cn: 不知道有没有其他办法能弄到黑棘海的那些鱼呢……

choice_prompt:12:1222403010.text: I wonder if there are other ways to get those fish from the Blackthorn Sea...
choice_prompt:12:1222403010.source_cn: 不知道有没有其他办法能弄到黑棘海的那些鱼呢……

say:13:1222403011:1.text: Hee-hee... I'm new in Rustport, so you're my only hope.
say:13:1222403011:1.source_cn: 嘿嘿……我在锈锚港人生地不熟，只能求你帮忙。
say:13:1222403011:1.male: Hee-hee... I'm new in Rustport, so you're my only hope.
say:13:1222403011:1.female: Hee-hee... I'm new in Rustport, so you're my only hope.

say:14:1222403013:1.text: According to that fisherman just now, there are several types of fish in the Blackthorn Sea.
say:14:1222403013:1.source_cn: 刚才那位捕鱼人告诉我，黑棘海里有好几种鱼。

say:15:1222403014:1.text: The society's interested in the following species: <style="highlight">inkfish</style>, <style="highlight">rot flounder</style>, <style="highlight">flyfish</style>, and <style="highlight">blue tang</style>. Just to be safe, we need <style="highlight">a live fish of each species</style>!

choice:12:0:1.source_cn: 我好像听到有人在暗示我

Will you help me if I ask?!
Well, please do me this favor then!
say:17:1222403012:1.source_cn: 只要求你就可以吗？！\n那就拜托了，求求你帮我这个忙吧！

say:17:1222403012:1.female:

choice:12:1:2.text: I'll help if you ask nicely.
choice:12:1:2.male: I'll help if you ask nicely.
choice:12:1:2.female: I'll help if you ask nicely.

choice:8:0:1.male: How much is he asking for?
choice:8:0:1.female: How much is he asking for?

say:18:1222403009:1.text: That idea has crossed my mind... but I can't do it! It goes against my principles as a scholar.
say:18:1222403009:1.source_cn: 虽然我也这样想过……但绝对不行！那样做会违背我身为学者...

choice:8:1:2.text: Just pretend you aren't aware of these fish.
choice:8:1:2.source_cn: 你可以假装不知道这些鱼的存在
choice:8:1:2.male: Just pretend you aren't aware of these fish.
choice:8:1:2.female: Just pretend you aren't aware of these fish.

say:0:1222404001:0.text: Finally, we've caught the fish Leonor needs! For some reason, she seems more enthusiastic than usual this time...
say:0:1222404001:0.source_cn: 总算收集齐莱诺曼小姐要的鱼了！不知道为什么，满满总觉得...

say:2:1222405001:1.text: You guys are back! Did you manage to catch those fish from the Blackthorn Sea?
say:2:1222405001:1.source_cn: 可算等到你们回来了！怎么样，有没有在黑棘海里钓到那几种鱼？

choice_prompt:3:1222405001.text: You guys are back! Did you manage to catch those fish from the Blackthorn Sea?
choice_prompt:3:1222405001.source_cn: 可算等到你们回来了！怎么样，有没有在黑棘海里钓到那几种鱼？

say:4:1222405002:1.text: Wonderful! You're indeed the most promising fish catcher in Rustport!
say:4:1222405002:1.source_cn: ——太好了！你果然是锈锚港最有潜力的捕鱼人！
say:4:1222405002:1.male: Wonderful! You're indeed the most promising fish catcher in Rustport!
say:4:1222405002:1.female: Wonderful! You're indeed the most promising fish catcher in Rustport!

say:5:1222405004:1.text: I really appreciate your help! With these fish, I believe our research can proceed smoothly!
say:5:1222405004:1.source_cn: 这次也多谢你的帮忙！有了这些鱼，我们的研究报告一定能顺...
say:5:1222405004:1.male: I really appreciate your help! With these fish, I believe our research can proceed smoothly!
say:5:1222405004:1.female: I really appreciate your help! With these fish, I believe our research can proceed smoothly!

say:6:1222405005:1.text: Eh? "Your" research? Are you involved in the study too?
say:6:1222405005:1.source_cn: 哎？你们的研究报告……？你也开始研究锈锚港的鱼类了？

say:7:1222405006:1.text: That's right. The expert I'm assisting thinks I'm doing a great job, and he's decided to accept me as his student slash assistant.
say:7:1222405006:1.source_cn: 没错。我跟随的那位鱼类专家觉得我帮上了许多忙，所以打算...

say:8:1222405007:1.text: Most importantly, he's promised to make me the co-author of the research paper! This is much simpler than investigating the ruins, and we'll get results more quickly!
say:8:1222405007:1.source_cn: 最重要的是——他答应把锈锚港鱼类研究报告的二作留给我，...

say:9:1222405008:1.text: Ah, that explains why you're so enthusiastic this time...
say:9:1222405008:1.source_cn: 呃……难怪你这次会一反常态，变得这么积极……

say:10:1222405009:1.text: Well, the Conservatory has too many students and too few mentors. My previous mentor only checked in with me every couple of months because he had too many students...
say:10:1222405009:1.source_cn: 当然了。谁让冬青学会的学者那么多，导师却少之又少。我原...

say:11:1222405010:1.text: So, my mentor now is a rare find! I don't get why no other scholars have picked him. He's just, well... a bit bossy at times...
say:11:1222405010:1.source_cn: 所以说，我现在这位导师简直称得上绝无仅有！真不明白为什...

say:12:1222405011:1.text: Oh! I've got to pass these fish to him immediately, or he'll soon hunt me down to nag me!
say:12:1222405011:1.source_cn: ——啊！我得赶紧把这些鱼交给他，不然他又要跑出来催我了！！

say:13:1222405012:1.text: See you, everyone! Thanks for supporting the Fishing Society!
say:13:1222405012:1.source_cn: 再见啦，各位，谢谢你们对于钓鱼协会的支持！

choice:3:0:1.text: Of course, I'm a fishing expert!
choice:3:0:1.male: Of course, I'm a fishing expert!
choice:3:0:1.female: Of course, I'm a fishing expert!

say:15:1222405003:1.text: Don't worry, you'll surely get a fair reward from me!
say:15:1222405003:1.source_cn: 放心，我会给你合适的报酬~
say:15:1222405003:1.male: Don't worry, you'll surely get a fair reward from me!
say:15:1222405003:1.female: Don't worry, you'll surely get a fair reward from me!
